description_en: Uploads a file directly to the Bucket/ObjectKey specified in the response, and then uses the object URL as OssFileUrl to create a parsing task
description_zh: 调用方将文件直接上传到响应指定的 Bucket/ObjectKey，再将对象 URL 作为 OssFileUrl 创建解析任务
name: AuthorizeFileUpload

parameters.help_en: The region ID, such as cn-beijing
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Agent or client source that initiates the call, such as codex, cursor, or openapi. Maximum length: 32 characters. Used only for statistics and does not participate in authentication, throttling, quota, or billing
parameters.help_zh: 发起调用的 Agent/客户端来源，如 codex / cursor / openapi；最长 32 字符，仅用于统计，不参与鉴权、限流、配额或计费
parameters.name: agent_name

parameters.help_en: The format of the file to be uploaded
parameters.name: file_format
